scope: 既有软件开发原运行与显式恢复的只读实验汇总；9次实际尝试与8个最终槽分别统计；不重跑、不重评，不声明同协议效能或训练收益。

inference_profiles.lora_scope: Full-attention projections only; DeltaNet is frozen
inference_profiles.history_policy: Full public messages supplied to official template; non-thinking requested; preserve_thinking=False
inference_profiles.dtype_scope: Frozen text backbone BF16; frozen untied LM head FP32, with hidden states promoted BEFORE its matrix multiplication and FP32 output. Trainable LoRA and its matmuls FP32; PEFT projection results return to BF16. Sampling and full-input selected-token normalization FP32. Official DeltaNet/RMSNorm/rotary FP32 intermediates retained.

chat_stop_contract.source: Registered official tokenizer EOS, token vocabulary and assistant chat-template terminator

inference_profiles.checkpoint_scope: Official text backbone and LM head; unused vision/MTP excluded
inference_profiles.deltanet_runtime: Installed official PyTorch reference; no optional fast kernels

parser_contract.validation: Original native parser acceptance; diagnostics use supplied public parameter types without changing later world/SDK validation

inference_profiles.lm_head_contract: Untied bias-free Linear; actual FP32 weight and pre-projection input; output remains FP32

actual_parameter_storage.scope: Actual tensor storage only; excludes cache, activations, gradients, optimizer and allocator overhead

inference_profiles.dtype_enforcement: Base/adapter storage verified at construction and execution; QKV/normalization checked when executed

control_summary.scope: CPU qualification, not model rollouts or a learned-policy comparator

definitions.model_requests: one durable transport call stem; started and finished duplicates counted once
definitions.http_status: resident_direct compatibility status, not external network API activity
definitions.usage: only returned usage; pre-generation rejection has no usage and contributes no generated tokens
definitions.generation_observed: returned choices and no explicit generation_started=false
definitions.episode_wall_seconds: attempt row ended_at minus started_at; missing boundary remains null
definitions.worker_gpu_seconds: supervisor worker process occupancy incl loading/assessment, not measured active CUDA time
definitions.service_seconds_sum: resident service generation wall seconds summed over requests, not kernel-only GPU time
definitions.peak_gpu_allocated_bytes: max of resident PyTorch allocator peaks reported by returned calls; not nvidia-smi whole-device peak
definitions.world_tool_successes: response.ok=true means execution accepted; run_tests may still return failing tests
definitions.history_projection: SDK recent-history selection and repaired capacity fitting are separate stages
definitions.recovery_comparison: selected unfinished cases with changed interface; not random assignment or repair effect estimate
definitions.R: unknown and never-started are null, never zero-filled; selected 4/8 is only a completion ledger
